headline: Titans Place Guards Fernando Carmona, Jackson Slater On IR
summary: The Titans lost two guards in Sunday’s loss to the Giants, and both are now headed for multi-game absences. Tennessee placed Fernando Carmona and Jackson Slater on injured reserve on Tuesday, per a team announcement. headline: Ravens-Cowboys in Brazil averaged record 24.9M viewers
summary: The Ravens' 34-31 victory over the Cowboys in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, averaged 24.9 million viewers on CBS on Sunday, making it the most-watched NFL international game in history.

headline: Jalen Hurts: I felt fine during concussion check, wish they could have expedited things
summary: Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts had to leave the game for a concussion evaluation after getting hit on the sideline during Monday night's loss to the Bears, and that proved costly for the Eagles: They were in the red zone at the time, but they came away with no points when backup quarterback Andy Dalton threw an interception.
